idea-plugin.name: Cert Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A native, client-side viewer for X.509 certificates and keystores — .pem, .crt, .cer, .der, .jks, .p12, .pfx. Shows subject, issuer, serial number, validity (with a clear warning when a certificate is expired or expiring soon), signature algorithm, SHA-256 fingerprint, and every alias in a multi-entry keystore.

PEM bundles with multiple certificates are rendered one certificate at a time, each with its own "Copy Raw PEM" button — no unreadable multi-cert block, and a real way to copy the raw certificate content.

100% client-side, using only the JDK's own java.security.KeyStore and java.security.cert APIs — no bundled crypto library, no network access. Keystore passwords are only ever asked for on demand and never cached.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, and it works correctly in both dark and light themes.
